title: ANNEX 2 (Related to Article 6(2))
full_text:
ANNEX 2 (Related to Article 6(2))
Standards for Library Materials

Classification of university or college | Minimum basic number of books | Minimum annual increase in the number of books
--- | --- | ---
Junior colleges | At least 30 books per student | At least 1 book per student
Universities other than junior colleges | At least 70 books per student | At least 2 books per student

Notes:
1. "Book materials" means the following categories of library materials:
  (a) Printed materials, excluding serial publications;
  (b) Manuscript materials, excluding serial publications;
  (c) Electronic books among electronic materials.
2. "Basic number of books" means the total number of book materials registered at the university or college library concerned.
3. "Annual increase in the number of books" means the number of book materials newly registered during the year concerned, limited to book materials purchased by the university or college concerned.
4. "Junior college" means a school under Article 2, subparagraph 4, of the Higher Education Act.
5. Standards for library materials other than book materials shall be determined in consideration of the number of students, library facilities and other circumstances, to the extent that the teaching and learning of students and faculty members are not impeded.
